title: Bank Holiday on October 26: What the RBI Calendar Means for You
description: Many bank branches across India will observe a holiday on October 26, 2026, for various regional festivals and events. The specific holidays, such as Laxmi Pu.

faq.q: Are all banks in India closed on October 26, 2026?
faq.a: No, bank holidays on October 26, 2026, are regional. While some states will observe closures for festivals like Laxmi Puja, Accession Day, or Maharishi Valmiki's Birthday, banks in other states will remain open.

faq.q: Can I still use online banking services during a bank holiday?
faq.a: Yes, digital banking services such as net banking, mobile banking, UPI, IMPS, and NEFT operate 24/7, even on bank holidays. You can perform most transactions online without any interruption.

faq.q: Will ATMs be functional on a bank holiday?
faq.a: ATMs are generally functional for cash withdrawals and deposits. However, cash replenishment services might be slower in some areas due to the holiday, so it's advisable to plan urgent cash needs in advance.

faq.q: What happens to cheque clearances on a bank holiday?
faq.a: Cheques deposited on a bank holiday will typically be processed on the next working day. This means the credit to your account will be delayed until the bank reopens for business.

faq.q: How can I find out the exact bank holidays for my state?
faq.a: You can find the official list of bank holidays for all states and union territories on the Reserve Bank of India's (RBI) official website under their holiday calendar section.
